title: Physical Quantity
content: A physical quantity is the quantity that can be measured, and consists of a numerical magnitude and a unit.
e: A physical quantity is the quantity that can be measured, and consists of a numerical magnitude and a unit. Physical Quantity is a measurable amount written as a number times a unit.

title: Unit
content: Unit is a quantity or an amount used as a standard of measurement.
e: Unit is a quantity or an amount used as a standard of measurement. Unit is an agreed amount you use as the scale of a measurement. You compare the unknown amount with a standard so the result is a number with a unit.

title: Standard
content: Standard is something or a reference used as a measure for length, mass and time.
e: Standard is something or a reference used as a measure for length, mass and time. Standard is the reference you compare length, mass, or time against.

title: Derived Unit
content: A derived unit is a unit of measurement formed by combining the basic (or base) units of a system.
e: A derived unit is a unit of measurement formed by combining the basic (or base) units of a system. Derived Unit is an agreed amount you use as the scale of a measurement. SI writes every quantity as a number times an agreed unit.
